newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Negros says in shipyard jv with Kvaerner.
newsitem.headline: Negros says in shipyard jv with Kvaerner.

text.p: The Philippines' Negros Navigation said it signed a ship-building contract as well as a memorandum of understanding for a joint venture shipyard with Singapore's Kvaerner Fjellstrand (S) Pte Ltd.
A Negros notice to the Securities and Exchange Commission said the contract was "for the construction of one brand new flying catamaran for use in our ferry routes."
The vessel has a passenger capacity of 340 and is scheduled for delivery at the end of October, 1996.

The notice, a copy of which was released by the SEC on Thursday, also said Negros "had entered into a memorandum of understanding with the manufacturer of these fly-cats to embark on a joint venture shipyard for the manufacture of these fly-cats in the Philippines".
The notice gave no further details.
